lines.t: I been walkin’ through the fire with a heavy soul
Tryin’ to keep it together, but the hurt don’t go
Every corner of my heart got a story to tell
I been cryin’ out for mercy, Lord, You know me well
When the night gets long and the road runs cold
I hear Your voice in the still, deep down in my soul
It’s the heart of the matter, Lord, the heart of the fight
When my world falls apart, You make it right
Take this broken heart and wash it clean
You’re the mercy in my misery, the joy in my need
It’s the heart of the matter, where Your love comes through
I got nothin’ left to hide when I come to You
When the storm blows wild and I lose my way
You steady my soul, and You hear me pray
It’s the heart of the matter, Lord, the heart of the fight
When my world falls apart, You make it right
Take this broken heart and wash it clean
You’re the mercy in my misery, the joy in my need
It’s the heart of the matter, where Your love comes through
I got nothin’ left to hide when I come to You
Oh, I surrender, yeah, I surrender now
Take my shaking hands and turn this sorrow around
From the ashes, from the pain, let Your goodness rise
Make a hallelujah out of these weary nights
It’s the heart of the matter, Lord, the heart of the fight
When my world falls apart, You make it right
Take this broken heart and wash it clean
You’re the mercy in my misery, the joy in my need
It’s the heart of the matter, where Your love comes through
I got nothin’ left to hide when I come to You
Yeah, I got nothin’ left to hide
When I come to You
It’s the heart of the matter
And You’re bringin’ me through
